description:
System Requirements:

  • The magazine shall be able to carry the MJU-68/B flare and interface with the AN/ALE-52 Dispensing System
  • Quantity required: 846 magazines
  • The magazine shall be qualified to airworthiness requirements IAW the F-22 Environmental Control Document for certification purposes (including, but not limited to: salt-fog, vibration, gunfire, temperature extremes tests)
  • Due to the time constraints, must be able to commence manufacturing by Oct 2026
  • Must have a high quality CPAR Rating
